guideContent.strategyOverview: Sauron, the Dark Lord is the engine that powers a tutored Thassa's Oracle combo deck. Sauron amasses Orcs every time an opponent casts a spell, building card advantage, Ring temptation looting, and Bargain/sacrifice fuel via token production. The deck's primary win condition is Thassa's Oracle + Demonic Consultation (3 mana, tutorable with five tutors). Backup plans include Beseech-the-Mirror tutoring and free-casting Oracle off a sacrificed Army token, Breach the Multiverse reanimation, and a lethal Army swing with shadow/menace evasion. Free interaction (Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship, Deadly Rollick, Deflecting Swat) protects the combo turn or stops opposing wincons.

winConditions.title: Thassa's Oracle + Demonic Consultation (Primary)
winConditions.description: Cast Thassa's Oracle (UU). With her ETB trigger on the stack, cast Demonic Consultation (B) naming a card you do not own. Consultation resolves first, exiling your entire library. Oracle's trigger resolves on a 0-card library — X (devotion ≥ 1) ≥ 0 (library) — you win. 3 mana total. Tutorable with all five tutors in the deck.

sources.name: The Command Zone - Bracket 4 (Ep 731)
sources.detail: Cited as the expected 2-card kill in B4+ blue combo decks

winConditions.title: Beseech the Mirror — Single-Card Win
winConditions.description: Once Sauron has triggered once and created an Orc Army token, Bargain on the token to cast Beseech the Mirror ({1}{B}{B}{B}). Tutor Thassa's Oracle and cast her for free (Bargain free-cast clause, MV 2 ≤ 4). Then cast Demonic Consultation (B) to win — total mana 5 (4 for Beseech + 1 for Consultation). A 5-mana T5–T6 win line off a single tutored card.

winConditions.title: Breach the Multiverse Reanimation (Backup)
winConditions.description: Ring temptation fills your graveyard. Breach the Multiverse mills each player 10, then reanimates a creature/planeswalker from each graveyard. Steal opponents' best threats while reanimating Sauron or a pre-discarded Thoracle. Combined with Reanimate / Animate Dead / Stitch Together, rebuild from any position or recover a countered combo piece.

winConditions.title: Lethal Army Swing (Tertiary)
winConditions.description: If the combo is disrupted and the table forgets about Sauron, the Army can still win combat. In the Darkness Bind Them produces menace Wraiths, The Black Gate makes a creature unblockable by the life leader, and Minas Morgul grants shadow. A 15+ power Army with evasion one-shots opponents through commander damage.

synergies.title: Amass Snowball
synergies.description: Sauron amasses every time an opponent casts a spell. Call of the Ring tempts you on upkeep, triggering Sauron's Ring-bearer looting. synergies.title: Graveyard Recursion
synergies.description: Ring temptation fills your graveyard with creatures. Reanimate brings back any creature for 1 mana. Animate Dead does the same from any graveyard for {1}{B}. Stitch Together returns a creature to battlefield with Threshold (trivial with Ring looting). Breach the Multiverse mills everyone 10, then steals a creature from each graveyard. Worldgorger Dragon + Animate Dead creates an infinite mana loop: Dragon exiles all other permanents including Animate Dead, which returns everything, float mana each cycle, break the loop by targeting a different creature.

tokens.name: The Ring
tokens.oracle_text:
Your Ring-bearer is legendary and can't be blocked by creatures with greater power.
Whenever your Ring-bearer attacks, draw a card, then discard a card.
Whenever your Ring-bearer becomes blocked by a creature, that creature's controller sacrifices it at end of combat.
Whenever your Ring-bearer deals combat damage to a player, each opponent loses 3 life.
